newsitem.title: USA: Aetna to name Sebastianelli president - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Aetna to name Sebastianelli president - WSJ.

text.p: Aetna Inc is expected to name Joseph Sebastianelli, the co-president of its health care unit, as either president or vice chairman, the Wall Street Journal said in its Friday electronic edition.
The report said such a promotion for Sebastianelli would make him a potential successor to Chairman and Chief Executive Ronald Compton, who is planning to retire in a year.
The report said Leonard Abramson, who has a three percent stake in the company and is its single largest individual shareholder, is pressing fellow board members to promote Sebastianelli.
The report said Abramson could not be reached for comment but attributed the information to people familiar with the situation.
